title: rpt report record
description: The whole render-ready document emitted by rpt assemble, as one record on one line.

findings.description: Sorted by the config's severity order, then by ID.

pages.description: The pages in report order; report.order says where the findings go among them.

reportPage.description: A page of report-level prose, its body links made absolute.

path.description: The page file, relative to the report root.

body.description: Markdown; ## headings in it are the page's own.

assets.description: Every file the page lists or links, one per source and ref; links in body now name file.

severities.description: The report's severity levels, most severe first.

sections.description: The report's sections in the order rpt writes them: the fixed ones with this report's headings, then the custom ones it requires, as rpt config get gives them.

order.description: The report's parts in reading order: each page's ID, and findings where the findings go.

key.description: The key a finding's sections use: description, remediation, poc, or a custom section's heading.

heading.description: The heading this report gives the section, for a reader.

path.description: The finding file, relative to the report root.

targets.description: The finding's targets, each with its full scope row in place of the scope ID.

assets.description: Every file the finding lists or links, one per source and ref; links in sections now name file.

reportTarget.description: A finding target with its scope row in full; host, port and protocol as in finding.schema.json#/$defs/target.
